The flagged reply contains a direct, specific threat of real-world physical violence — "If we were in the same room right now I'd literally choke you out…" — which falls squarely under the Violence and physical harm category. Threatening to assault another user is not permitted even as trash talk, so the message should be taken down.

rounds.consequence: The previously reviewed threat was removed from the gaming thread, which halted further escalation there; the original participants did not continue the argument after seeing the comment disappear and the thread drifted off the front page.
